Some of CJ's observations contradict Liberation War spirit
2017-08-20T00:00:00+06:00 | Staff Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/city/some-cjs-observations-contradict-liberation-war-spirit-1451134

Some observations of Chief Justice Surendra Kumar Sinha in the 16th constitutional amendment verdict go against the spirit of the Liberation War, said war crimes researcher Shahriar Kabir yesterday.

"Our statement is that if we legalise the verdict by expunging one word, we will betray our democracy, our constitution and particularly the 30 lakh martyrs and Liberation War," he said at a discussion in the capital.

Ekattorer Ghatak Dalal Nirmul Committee organised the discussion marking the 42nd death anniversary of the Father of the Nation Bangabandhu Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.

Shahriar Kabir, also president of the Committee, said it was only Bangabandhu who led the Liberation War although many leaders had contributions in achieving the independence.

The denial of his role in the war goes against the spirit of the Liberation War, he said.
